items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Hiram Johnson backed him on one of his inventions

ctx.x: Well, yeah, but he got, I think, $400,000, but he had...he had a coupla fellas that were in on that 'cause they gave him money to build it, you know how that is. It was a couple of saloon men in Bisbee, called the Spires Brothers.
You were telling me--I don't think the tape was on when you told me Hiram Johnson backed him on one of his inventions.

On the...on that...measuring thing for gasoline stations. And you know who his lawyer was in all of that time? Uh... what's the guy went to...got to be head of the Supreme Court...that was from Los Angeles? The Governor of California?
